deha ādi upādāna bhūtasya avidyā leśasya anuvṛteḥ iti arthaḥ pūrva mate
jīvanmukti asiddhim āha

original: ajñānavaditi jīvanmuktasya dehādi pratibhāsa ityarthaḥ | virodhinīti |
analyzed: ajñāna vat iti jīvanmuktasya deha ādi pratibhāsaḥ iti arthaḥ virodhinī iti
ajñānasya iva prārabdha karmaṇaḥ api sākṣāt virodhinī iti arthaḥ śrī kṛṣṇam

original: manasā dhyātvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ saṃpraṇamya ca vyākhyāto yaṃ parichedaḥ
analyzed: manasā dhyātvā śrī kṛṣṇam saṃpraṇamya ca vyākhyātaḥ yam parichedaḥ
śrī kṛṣṇa parituṣṭaye
iti śrīmat paramahaṃsa parivrājika ācārya
śrīmat svayam prakāśa ānaṃda sarasvastī divya
śrī caraṇa araviṃda saṃlagna rajaḥ bhūtasya acyuta kṛṣṇa ānaṃdatīrthasya kṛtau
śāstrasiddhāṃtaleśasaṃgraha vyākhyāyām śrī kṛṣṇālaṃkāra ākhyāyām
tṛtīyaḥ parichedaḥ samāptam
